items.headline: Pochettino's Man United debut turns into an Anfield nightmare
items.body: Talk about a baptism of fire: Mauricio Pochettino's first game in charge of Manchester United was a 4-0 thrashing at Liverpool on Sunday. Leny Yoro was sent off inside eight minutes, Dominik Szoboszlai and Florian Wirtz struck early, and Rio Ngumoha and Víctor Muñoz piled on late — leaving United sliding toward the relegation zone.
items.say: Pochettino's first game as Man United boss was a 4-0 loss at Liverpool — red card in the first 10 minutes and everything. Brutal welcome. You follow the Premier League at all?

items.headline: 296 points in Chicago — Nuggets outlast Bulls in overtime
items.body: The highest-scoring game of the season so far: Denver beat Chicago 151-145 in OT. Jamal Murray dropped 45, Nikola Jokić stuffed the sheet with a 37-18-11 triple-double, and on the other side Josh Giddey answered with one of the wildest lines you'll see — 23 points, 14 rebounds and 22 assists.
items.say: Nuggets and Bulls put up 296 points in overtime last night — Jokić had a triple-double and the Bulls' Giddey had 22 assists. Absolute track meet. You catching any NBA this season?

items.headline: Bam does a bit of everything as the Heat trip up the Thunder
items.body: Miami handed red-hot Oklahoma City a 123-113 loss on Sunday, and Bam Adebayo was the engine with a 24-15-12 triple-double. The Thunder have the league's best player in Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, but they keep running into teams that smell an upset.
items.say: Bam Adebayo had a triple-double as the Heat knocked off the Thunder last night — OKC keeps getting everyone's best shot. You a Heat guy, or riding with anybody this year?

items.headline: The Thanksgiving football menu is set
items.body: Three games Thursday: Bears at Lions for the early appetizer, Eagles at Cowboys in the afternoon main course, and Chiefs at Bills under the lights for dessert. There's even a Thanksgiving-Eve game Wednesday night — Packers at Rams on Netflix — so the couch is booked all week.
items.say: The Thanksgiving football lineup's out — Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys, then Chiefs-Bills at night. Perfect nap-on-the-couch slate. You hosting, or just showing up for the food and the games?

items.headline: Feast Week tips off — the Maui Invitational starts today
items.body: The best early-season bonanza in college basketball is here. Monday's opening round in Lahaina stacks No. 12 Arizona vs. Colorado State, Clemson vs. Ole Miss, BYU vs. Washington and Providence vs. VCU — back-to-back hoops all day and into the night on the ESPN networks.
items.say: The Maui Invitational tips off today — all those Thanksgiving-week college hoops with ranked teams, games all day. Great leftovers-and-couch viewing. You into college basketball at all?

items.headline: One month out — 'Avengers: Doomsday' is the December event
items.body: Mark December 18: Marvel's biggest crossover yet lands with Robert Downey Jr. back in the MCU, this time as the villain Doctor Doom. The Russo brothers direct a cast that pulls in the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and even the X-Men — and it opens the same day as 'Dune: Part Three.'
items.say: The new Avengers movie is about a month out, and Robert Downey Jr. is back — as the bad guy this time. That plus a new Dune the same weekend? December's going to be a scene. You still keep up with the Marvel stuff?

items.headline: Ella Langley just made Hot 100 history
items.body: Her country smash 'Choosin' Texas' has now spent a record stretch at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 — the longest reign the chart has ever seen. The star-studded video (Miranda Lambert and 'Yellowstone' star Luke Grimes both pop up) helped turn it into the song of the year.
items.say: That Ella Langley song 'Choosin' Texas' just broke the all-time record for most weeks at No. 1 — it will not leave the top of the charts. You heard it yet? It's everywhere.

items.headline: Nate Bargatze's new special drops just in time for the holidays
items.body: The famously clean, deadpan 'nicest guy in comedy' returns with his fourth Netflix special, 'Good for Nathan,' premiering Tuesday after a record-breaking tour. Easy, everybody-can-watch-it comedy — the kind you can quote at the dinner table without anyone getting mad.
items.say: Nate Bargatze has a new Netflix special out tomorrow — he's that super clean, low-key funny comedian. Perfect thing to throw on over the holiday. You a fan?

items.headline: 'Thriller' is somehow charting higher than ever
items.body: File under wild: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' — a song from 1982 — just climbed to a brand-new all-time peak of No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100, 40-plus years after it came out. The greatest music video ever made is apparently immortal.
items.say: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' just hit a new all-time high on the charts — a song from 1982. How is that even possible? That video still holds up, right?
